listenings.text: Hello, Doctor Nilo, Sofia here from the FIFA Leadership in Football program office. Welcome to Block 3. Before your orientation call on Monday, here is a short overview of the program. The program has three modules: the first one in Miami, the second one in Rabat, and the third one in Zurich. Between the modules, you will work online with your cohort, and you will have one written assignment after each of the first two modules. Every participant also has a mentor, a former participant who will call you once a month. The workload is about two hours a week, so please plan your agenda now. By the end of the Miami module, you will have met all the participants in your cohort. By the time you arrive in Zurich, you will have completed two modules and two assignments. And if everything goes well, you will graduate in Zurich and receive your certificate there. I will send the full itinerary for Miami next week. See you on Monday.

Hi Nilo, my name is Daniel, and I am going to be your mentor in the program. Three years ago, I was exactly where you are now. I was a lawyer at a football club, I was a little nervous about my English, and I had a very full agenda. So let me give you three pieces of advice. First, do the assignments early. If you start on the last weekend, the workload will feel enormous. Second, talk to your peers. By the end of the program, you will have learned as much from them as from the lectures. Third, keep a small notebook in English. By the time you graduate, you will have written a hundred pages of ideas, and you will use them for years. I will call you next Thursday, and we can make a plan for the Miami module together. Welcome to the cohort.
